card.name: Supplement markers in journal citations
card.fires_on: The letter S or the word Supplement right after a volume, issue or page number in a journal reference. It marks a supplement issue, as in 472S-478S or Suppl. 2.

modes.label: S after a number
modes.description: A capital S attached to a volume, issue or page number in a citation.
modes.example: (Morbidity and Mortality Weekly Report Supplement, Volume 34, Number 4<<S>>, October 18, 1

modes.label: Supplement spelled out
modes.description: The word Supplement or its abbreviation Suppl. inside a citation.
modes.example: Clinical Therapeutics, Volume 22,<< Supplement>> B, April 2000

card.plain: It spots the little S or the word Supplement in a journal reference that points to a supplement issue.
